content.text:
The sheet is out of date. It hasn't been updated since the route changed.

- **Vendor sheet:** vendors.csv V1 rev1 lists Monday and Thursday. It was last reviewed 2026-09-14.
- **Note N09:** Maya wrote this on 2026-09-25 (notes.csv N09 rev1). It says the Alder rep confirmed the route changes on Sept 28 to Monday/Wednesday instead of Monday/Thursday. Orders are due by noon the day before. Wednesday has to get you through the weekend.

The sheet predates the change by about two weeks. I can't see why nobody updated it, because the restaurant doesn't record that.

Under the sources.precedence policy, the newer note overrides the reference table. The ledger holds Monday/Wednesday for Alder (assertion vendor.V1.delivery_days, from N09). The sheet stays flagged as stale.

You said it's "always Wednesday". The records only show Monday/Wednesday starting Sept 28, with Thursday before that.
